verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at workos.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), a markdown docs index at /docs.md, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec. The cited documentation pages are also served as .md variants (e.g. /docs/sso.md, /docs/mcp.md), so an agent can ingest them directly. Missing for 10: first-party documentation explaining how to use llms.txt or the markdown docs with agents, and independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs.
